what: Automatic umbilicus vs hand-made umbilici (herculaneum-umbilici, MIT): VC3D align_and_extract_umbilicus estimator (port) with and without a PCA un-crush step
truth: Drobkov manual umbilici, 10 First Letters scrolls; m7 L2 slices, 8 per scroll at 10-90 % of the annotated z range
rule: alpha chosen on 3 dev scrolls (lowest median error) before reading the 7 test scrolls
note: unread scrolls coded S01-S10 as elsewhere in results/; the benchmark code names them because it fetches the public manual umbilici by name
negative_results: straight Theil-Sen line through z over the whole scroll: 5-10 mm (axes bend)
top-6 candidates + z-continuity (Viterbi), 8 and dense z: no meaningful gain; failures are consistent decoys (folds)

vc3d_native_input.input: published normal grids (GridStore v3), VC3D estimator on segment midpoints + perpendicular normals, alpha 0.5 fixed in advance
vc3d_native_input.note: primary alone borderline (p = 0.076); direction and size replicate the m7-route result
